name: Houngan (Bokor Archetype)
body:
A houngan (or mambo if female) is a priest of the Vodou faith. They act as servants of the spirits and help facilitate communication with an enigmatic god. A houngan must be of a good alignment. A non-good houngan loses access to all of this class features and his soul ward is immediately dismissed. In order to atone and regain the use of his class features, a ritual of self-penance involving the consultation of otherworldly spirits is required.

Houngan Soul Ward (Su)

A houngan starts his day off with his soul ward at full hp rather than at half.

Spell Casting

A houngan is a divine spell caster who draws his spells from the cleric spell list rather than the sorcerer/wizard spell list. A houngan cannot cast spells of an alignment opposite to his own. The only exception to this is that a houngan can cast necromancy spells that allow him to call, command, or creature undead. Intelligent undead created by a houngan have the alignment they last had in life rather than being forced to be evil (however, most descend into evil ways if left reanimated for an extended period of time).

This modifies the bokor’s spell class feature.

Detect Alignment (Sp)

A houngan of 1st level adds detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, and detect law to the list of spells they can cast as 1st level spells.

Cast out the Wicked (Su)

A houngan’s soul drain only effects evil creatures.

Consume the Wicked (Su)

A houngan can only consume the soul of an evil aligned creatures.
